title: Entity
description: JSON Schema for an entity instance: a kebab-case slug identifying an element of an entity-set E. An entity carries no required internal structure beyond its slug; specific theories may impose sort-stratification via the optional sorts array. Via the predication fibration the entity acquires its slice-category bundle of incident cells (P/e) — that bundle is not part of the entity's own data.

slug.description: Kebab-case slug identifying the entity. Resolves via the resolve function ρ to a posix-file record in the 561 repository.

sorts.description: Optional list of sort-slugs this entity belongs to when E is sort-stratified. Sort membership is internal to E; entities meeting a sort σ are precisely those whose sorts array contains σ.
